basic_details.job_title: IGKV Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Guest Teacher / Part Time Teacher Posts
basic_details.short_information: Indira Gandhi Krishi Vishwavidyalaya (IGKV) is recruiting candidates for 1 Guest Teacher / Part Time Teacher post on a purely temporary basis for the academic session 2026-27. Candidates must apply offline by submitting the duly filled application by registered post or by hand to the Office of the Dean, BRSM College of Agricultural Engineering and Technology and Research Station, Pandariya Road on or before 23 October 2026, starting from 13 October 2026. The required qualification is a Master degree in relevant subject (Soil Science) of Agriculture faculty with at least 55% marks and NET/Ph.D.

post_wise_qualification.post_name: Soil Science Guest Teacher / Part Time Teacher

qualification.details: Qualification Required: Master degree in the relevant subject (Soil Science) of Agriculture faculty with at least 55% marks (or its equivalent grade 6.50 in 10.00 scale with good academic record), along with NET (National Eligibility Test) or Ph.D. For candidates having Master's degree, NET qualified shall remain compulsory along with one publication in NAAS rated journal for recruitment to the post of Assistant Professor and equivalent in the disciplines in which NET is conducted. Essentially NET can be waived off for the candidates holding Ph.D. degree provided it has been done with course work as prescribed by the UGC Regulations 2009, and the candidates has at least two full length publications having a NAAS rating not less than 4 on the last date of submission of application. Those candidates with Ph.D. degree without course work will not qualify nor NET Exemption. | Age Limit: Maximum age limit is 40 years. 5 years age relaxation for ST, SC, OBC and Women candidate as per C.G. Govt. rules.

selection_process: The selection involves shortlisting of eligible candidates based on qualifications. The date and time of interview will be communicated through email or message and will also be available on the official website www.igkv.ac.in.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Interested eligible candidates are required to submit duly filled application along with self-attested copies of certificates (Educational and other), relevant documents of experience and research papers, etc. by registered post or by hand only at the following address: Office of the Dean, BRSM College of Agricultural Engineering and Technology and Research Station, Pandariya Road, Mungeli – 495334 (C.G.)

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Qualification Required: Master degree in the relevant subject (Soil Science) of Agriculture faculty with at least 55% marks (or its equivalent grade 6.50 in 10.00 scale with good academic record), along with NET (National Eligibility Test) or Ph.D. For candidates having Master's degree, NET qualified shall remain compulsory along with one publication in NAAS rated journal for recruitment to the post of Assistant Professor and equivalent in the disciplines in which NET is conducted. Essentially NET can be waived off for the candidates holding Ph.D. degree provided it has been done with course work as prescribed by the UGC Regulations 2009, and the candidates has at least two full length publications having a NAAS rating not less than 4 on the last date of submission of application. Those candidates with Ph.D. degree without course work will not qualify nor NET Exemption. Age Limit: Maximum age limit is 40 years. 5 years age relaxation for ST, SC, OBC and Women candidate as per C.G. Govt. rules.

rows.post: Soil Science Guest Teacher / Part Time Teacher
rows.pay: Rs. 1,800/- Per Day for Ph.D. and NET qualified (Max Rs. 40,000/- per month); Rs. 1,800/- Per Day for Ph.D. qualified (Max Rs. 40,000/- per month); Rs. 1,500/- Per Day for Post Graduate and passed NET exam (Max Rs. 36,000/- Per Month); Rs. 1,200/- per day for post Graduate in relevant subject (Maximum Rs. 26,000/- per month)

faq.question: Q1. Is this post permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The post of Guest Teacher / part time teacher is purely temporary for the academic session 2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. Who gets a relaxation in age and how much?
faq.answer: Maximum age limit is 40 years, with a 5-year age relaxation provided for ST, SC, OBC, and Women candidates as per C.G. Govt. rules.

faq.question: Q3. How are candidates shortlisted for the position?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates are selected through an interview process, the date and time of which will be communicated through email/message and published on the website www.igkv.ac.in.

faq.question: Q4. Which documents must be sent with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must send self-attested copies of educational and other certificates, relevant experience documents, and research papers along with the duly filled application form.
